messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: embeddings-reranker pipeline error rate spike > 5% for /v1/embeddings/batch (service: reranker-service)

maya: paging SREs — I'm seeing a steady spike in 5xx from the reranker batch endpoints starting ~12:03 UTC. Customers reporting elevated latency + some 500s. Escalating to oncall.

kevin: confirmed, I see 502s clustered to reranker-v2 instances. Query sample: request id `batch-9d3f` returned `500` with payload size mismatch.

sheraz: sharing logs from pod `reranker-v2-7f8b` (tail 200 lines):
```
2026-03-15T12:03:12Z ERROR reranker.batch Handler: failing request batch-9d3f: vector length mismatch expected=768 got=512
2026-03-15T12:03:12Z WARN reranker.prep Batch size=64, first_item_len=512
2026-03-15T12:03:13Z ERROR downstream.client RekankerClient: upstream returned 502 Bad Gateway for model-embedder-1
```

beth: customer impact: two paying customers (acct: sentinel-ai, acct: lensly) reported degraded ranking results and elevated tail latency. No data exfiltration. Risk: mis-ranked search on live features.

maya: immediate mitigation — switched /v1/embeddings/batch to fallback model-embedder-0 (quantized, stable) and enabled strict vector length validation at the gateway to drop bad batches. Rolling restart of reranker-v2 group. Noting some traffic rerouted to dedicated fallback pool.

ops-bot: deploy bot: rolled out config `reranker-fallback-20260315` to prod at 12:07 UTC. Traffic shift: 30% -> fallback.

kevin: timeline so far: 12:02 UTC anomalous batch from upstream ingestion (job id ingest-1189) included truncated embedding vectors. By 12:03 pipeline started returning 500s when reranker attempted to concat vectors. 12:07 mitigation (fallback) reduced errors to ~0.8%.

sheraz: hypothesis list (in-thread, will iterate):
1) upstream batch generator (ingest) producing wrong vector size due to recent change in tokenizer/encoder commit `a7c3f` -> high likelihood.
2) reranker-v2 code path assumes 768 dims; missing defensive check — medium likelihood (we did add checks recently but maybe not on hot path).
3) downstream model service (model-embedder-1) responding 502 causing partial payloads -> low-medium.

maya: collecting artifacts for RCA: please paste failing batch payloads, ingestion job configs, and exact commit SHAs touched in last 24h. I'll own timeline building.

kevin: attaching query to fetch bad batch IDs (run):
```sql
SELECT batch_id, created_at, vector_len, status FROM batches WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-15T11:50:00Z' AND status != 'ok' ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 50;
```
Result samples: `batch-9d3f` vector_len=512, `batch-9e4a` vector_len=512, `batch-9f01` vector_len=768 - mixed.

beth: customer comms: prepping a short note for Sentinel & Lensly — "we detected a transient regression in embeddings used for reranking, mitigated at 12:07 UTC, service restored. We're investigating root cause and will follow up." Want approvals before sending.

maya: agree. I'll draft and share.

dan: taking handoff for on-call at 12:20 UTC — I'll continue RCA and own follow-ups. Key asks: full ingest job config for ingest-1189, last successful commit for encoder service, and full payloads for failing batches.

sheraz: posting encoder service commits in last 24h: `a6b2e` (perf), `a7c3f` (tokenizer tweak), `a7d01` (docstring). `a7c3f` touched padding/truncation behavior.

kevin: quick sanity check: we see two ingestion workers on image `ingest-worker:20260314-rc2`. Could be rollout mismatch: one worker built with older encoder. Running diff between artifacts now.

maya: note for timeline: 11:58 UTC ingest-1189 started; 12:02 first 512-len batch observed hitting reranker; 12:03 errors spike; 12:07 fallback applied; 12:15 errors down to baseline.

beth: from support desk: 3 tickets opened, 1 urgent customer callback requested. No SLA breach for now but PR for postmortem comms.

kevin: low-level log snippet from embedder service shows `Received partial payload length 2048 bytes` followed by `connection reset by peer` around 12:02:59Z. Might indicate upstream truncated embed send.

sheraz: added checklist items for RCA doc: reproduce locally with `batch-9d3f` payload, run integration against model-embedder-1, inspect ingest-worker logs and image tag.

maya: running repro now. Quick note — when validating other batches, we saw certain batches have 512 dim embedding for older models (compat mode). Looks like mixed fleet of encoder versions produced differing vector sizes.

dan: mitigation follow-ups: create syntactic gating at ingestion to enforce expected vector dim and reject batches with a clear error message (fail fast). Also require canary rollout monitor for encoder changes.

ops-bot: ticket created `INC-20260315-emb-rerank` assigned to eng-ml and eng-sre.

beth: comms draft for customers (proposed):
"Hi — we detected transient issues affecting the embeddings used in reranking which caused degraded rankings for a subset of requests between 12:02–12:07 UTC. We applied a mitigation and traffic was routed to a stable model. No data loss. We will follow up with root cause and prevention steps by EOD."

maya: +1. Once we validate upstream can produce consistent dims, we can close incident. Add postmortem owners: sheraz (root cause), dan (mitigations), beth (customer comms).

kevin: next actions I'm taking: diff ingest-worker images, dump env vars for encoder binary, and collect full payload samples to S3 bucket `s3://incidents/2026-03-15/emb-reranker/`. Will share links.

sheraz: uploading sample payloads now: `s3://incidents/.../batch-9d3f.json` (512 dims), `s3://incidents/.../batch-9f01.json` (768 dims).

maya: marking this thread for RCA coordination. Dan, please ping me if you need extended handoff. I'll publish a short timeline doc in #postmortems when we have root cause.

dan: acknowledged. Taking over active RCA. I'll create the internal postmortem and add timeline + hypothesis table there.

oncall-bot: NOTE: please ensure to include "customer impact" and "mitigation timeline" sections in the final RCA per policy.

maya: closing on-call handoff. Thanks all.
